en: Color-tinted historic view of a railway station labeled as Olskrokens station. Multiple railway tracks stretch into the distance with telephone poles along the line. On the right stands a station building with a red roof and light-colored walls, partially hidden by bushes. A railway employee in uniform stands near the tracks. Rolling green hills and a few distant industrial structures are visible under a cloudy sky. The bottom margin contains printed text from the publisher.
